CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-17. THE SELLER INPUT evidencing that Sales and the prospect have an agreed forward motion. A need with no next step is an observation, not a pursuit - which is why this is required alongside the need rather than instead of it. Deliberately NOT Opportunity.CloseDate: no Opportunity exists at SQL, and at conversion Salesforce sets that date itself. Deliberately NOT a buying timeline - a target decision date at this stage is a prediction rather than an established fact.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date of the next step agreed with the prospect.
CustomField.label: Next Step Date
